get_container.description: Look up a container's status: whether it's running, its health and last health check, exit code, when it started and stopped, restarts, image and ports.
get_container.name: get_container

parameters.description: The Docker environment the container is in, as Portainer names it, or its ID.
parameters.name: environment

parameters.description: The container: its name, such as shop-web-1, or its ID (from a trigger or an earlier step).
parameters.name: container

error.description: Docker's error, if it couldn't start

exit_code.description: The exit code it last stopped with

failing_streak.description: How many health checks in a row have failed

finished_at.description: When it last stopped (UTC); blank if never

health.description: healthy, unhealthy, starting, or none without a health check

last_health_check.description: What its last health check printed

link.description: A link to it in Portainer

oom_killed.description: Whether it was stopped for running out of memory

restart_count.description: How many times Docker has restarted it

restart_policy.description: Its restart policy: no, always, unless-stopped or on-failure

service.description: Its service in that stack, if any

short_id.description: Its short ID, the first 12 characters

stack.description: The stack (Compose project) it belongs to, if any

state.description: running, exited, restarting, paused, created or dead

get_container_logs.description: Read a container's recent logs: its last lines, or those since a time, output and errors or one of them, such as to post to a channel when it fails.
get_container_logs.display_str_template: Get the logs of Portainer container {1}.

lines.text: upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out)

mock_response.logs:
GET /health 200
upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out)

get_container_logs.name: get_container_logs

parameters.description: The Docker environment the container is in, as Portainer names it, or its ID.
parameters.name: environment

parameters.description: The container: its name, such as shop-web-1, or its ID (from a trigger or an earlier step).
parameters.name: container

parameters.description: How many of the newest lines. Defaults to 100.
parameters.name: lines

parameters.description: Only lines written since then: how far back, such as 30m, 2h or 1d, or a date and time such as 2026-11-06 09:00 (UTC).

parameters.name: stream

parameters.description: Start each line with when it was written (UTC).

logs.description: The lines, oldest first, as one text

state.description: Its state now, such as running or exited

truncated.description: Whether the text was cut, keeping the newest lines

description: Look after the containers Portainer manages from workflows: read a container's status and recent logs, start, stop, restart and recreate it, redeploy and update stacks, and clear unused images. Start a workflow when a container stops, turns unhealthy or comes back up.

portainer_container_back_up_trigger.description: Runs when a container that was stopped or unhealthy is running again, and healthy if it has a health check, such as to close an alert.

parameters.description: Only containers in this Docker environment, by name or ID. Leave blank for every one (up to 25).
parameters.name: environment

parameters.description: Only this container, by name, or names matching a pattern such as web-*. Leave blank for every container.
parameters.name: container

parameters.description: Only containers of this stack, by name. Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: stack

portainer_container_stopped_trigger.description: Runs when a container stops, crashes or is restarting after a crash, or only when it fails, with its exit code. Containers already stopped when the workflow is turned on don't run it.

parameters.description: Only containers in this Docker environment, by name or ID. Leave blank for every one (up to 25).
parameters.name: environment

parameters.description: Only this container, by name, or names matching a pattern such as web-*. Leave blank for every container.
parameters.name: container

parameters.description: Only containers of this stack, by name. Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: stack

parameters.description: Every stop, or only unexpected ones: an error exit code or out of memory, not a clean exit or Docker's stop. Leave blank for every stop.
parameters.name: which

portainer_container_unhealthy_trigger.description: Runs when a container's health check starts failing, with what the check printed. Containers already unhealthy when the workflow is turned on don't run it.

parameters.description: Only containers in this Docker environment, by name or ID. Leave blank for every one (up to 25).
parameters.name: environment

parameters.description: Only this container, by name, or names matching a pattern such as web-*. Leave blank for every container.
parameters.name: container

parameters.description: Only containers of this stack, by name. Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: stack
